summary: Repository development and quality tooling. Native Node 24 TypeScript tools use an explicit ESM package scope; shell and Python boundaries remain unchanged.

key_files.source-check-config.ts: Materializes runtime-specific source-check paths from root tsconfig.source.json plus sparse source-check-profiles.json. Default/check mode only reports drift; --write explicitly refreshes generated profiles.
key_files.source-check-config.test.ts: Tests preservation of browser/app-local aliases and non-mutating failure when shared mappings change.
key_files.executable-scripts.test.ts: Executes native imports and the agent bundler in isolated fixtures, preserving generated JavaScript package boundaries without a release build.
